title: Proforma for Analysis of Unit Rate of Underground Excavation by Cyclic Drilling and Blasting
clause_1_scope: This standard lays down proforma for analysis of unit rate of underground excavation by cyclic drilling and blasting. This standard does not include provisions for underground lining.
clause_3_terminology: Proforma for Analysis of Unit Rate of Underground Excavation by Cyclic Drilling and Blasting

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
